codebookReview: Cached full four-page codebook read. Exact literal participant combat endpoints retained. Ccode identifies source system member; participant alias is a separate unaccepted historical review contract. No legal declaration/peace/status/control/succession inferred.
policy: No new downloads. Exclude45 original accepted events. Missing-slot targeting only, actual event date retained, max5calendar-year explicit past context. No framework-crossing carryover. All candidates await independent coordinator historical/source review.
